label: wage-validate
_why: Dress rehearsal for the production `wages` metric before three ~100-year runs are committed to it. Probes 1 and 2 verified the individual CALLS; this verifies the assembled metric - both phases fire, both dump dates fire, the anchor/else_if successor chain picks the right country, the pop-type integer decodes, and WC/SW/PW all carry real values. It is also not a throwaway: at 1836.2.1 it IS Q1's measurement at n=1, so if the long batch is cut short the base-wage answer already exists.
_cost: One control run, 1836.1.1 + 1836.2.1 -> 1836.5.1. About three minutes.
